'Stale' means an artifact's OUTPUT WAS NOT REBUILT AFTER MAIN MOVED — its committed content differs from what its own generator produces from the committed inputs today. It does NOT mean a PR was built wrong or never merged; nothing is lost; the fix is to run `regenerate` and commit the result. Modes: regen-diff = the guard regenerates in a scratch worktree and compares every path (a pair is several paths of ONE artifact — regenerating one member without the other fails); not-committed = gitignored, rebuilt on every use, must stay untracked; historical = a one-off whose output is a dated record, never regenerated. 'volatile' lists the only lines allowed to differ between two runs of the same generator (measured by running it twice).
